quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's performance against the Spurs in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: How long was he going to go and keep killing until you made an adjustment like this?
quotes.quote: How long was he going to go and keep killing until you made an adjustment like this? You had to make an adjustment at some point. quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
